annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves the Beijing work plan for a national services-sector opening demonstration zone
Targets for 2025 and 2030 on trade, investment, data and talent facilitation
Supports connected/autonomous vehicle map applications and relaxed autonomous driving test road and licence management
Pilots cross-border data flow, data classification and data export security assessment
Inclusive and prudent regulation of new technologies and business models
annotation.summary_en: State Council reply (Guohan [2020] No. 123) approving Beijing's work plan to deepen pilot opening of the services sector and build a national demonstration zone. It is mainly economic opening policy, with minor provisions on autonomous driving testing, connected-vehicle maps and cross-border data flows.
annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于深化北京市新一轮服务业扩大开放综合试点建设国家服务业扩大开放综合示范区工作方案的批复
annotation.title_en: State Council Reply on the Work Plan for Deepening Beijing's New Round of Comprehensive Pilot Opening of the Services Sector and Building a National Services Opening Demonstration Zone
